purpose: Decorative category illustration for all papal-document search results; not a historical facsimile.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a bundled thumbnail illustration for papal encyclicals in the Cathopedia Catholic encyclopedia mobile app. Create ONE refined portrait-oriented category illustration, aspect ratio 3:4, designed to stay legible as a small 56 by 72 dp thumbnail. A cream parchment encyclical sheet with lightly curled lower edges resting on a dark forest-green writing desk, a graceful antique-gold quill at one side, small crossed gold keys of Saint Peter and a simple gold Christian cross as tasteful symbolic motifs, a small deep burgundy wax seal. Central parchment and keys must be large clear shapes, quietly detailed realistic devotional oil-painting / museum-quality editorial illustration with warm antique gold highlights and ivory paper against forest green #10291E, muted green shadows, restrained warm lighting and fine tactile paper grain. Elegant and coherent with Catholic sacred-art portraits in ornate gold frames, but do not add an outer frame; UI will supply the rounded thumbnail frame. Keep all essential objects inside the central 80% for portrait thumbnail cropping. An illustrative symbol of papal teaching, NOT a facsimile of an actual historical document. NO readable text, NO letters, NO signatures, NO document title, NO dates, NO watermark, NO official coat of arms or modern Vatican logo, NO portraits, NO dense miniature details, NO surrounding app UI. Full bleed opaque composition, not transparent. Single category artwork only.
